description: This file defines various macros, inline functions, and constants used in the sqlite3 integration with Node.js via Napi. It contains utility macros for argument validation, error handling, asynchronous work management, and some string manipulation functions for the Napi environment.

methods.name: StringConcat
methods.description: Concatenates two Napi::Value strings into an Napi::String.

methods.name: OtherIsInt
methods.description: Checks if a Napi::Number value is an integer.
